summary.text: Juanita Brent represents Ohio House District 18 and is serving her fourth term. She is Ranking Member of the House Agriculture Committee and a former President of the Ohio Legislative Black Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Before becoming a legislator, Brent sat on the board of trustees for the Harvard Community Services Center and the Lee-Harvard Community Development Corporation.
In the 133rd General Assembly, she authored House Bill 285, which established the Driver's License Reinstatement Fee Debt Reduction Program and became law in 2020.
She is also described as one of the founders of the Black Maternal Health Caucus.
